findings: Relief column always empty — store() never writes resource_id; the Relief/Resource column in the web history table and the field in the Flutter form will always render — . Either wire a resource selector or remove the column and field from both surfaces.

Flutter controller leak in read-only fields — Family Head and Purok TextFields construct a new TextEditingController inline on every build() call without disposing it. Promote these to state-level controllers initialized in initState() and updated in _selectFamily().

Scan status labels are inventory-oriented — check_in, check_out, audit, transfer describe warehouse operations, not family parcel handoffs. Labels like released, returned, verified would better match the distribution domain; confirm with the team before shipping.

scan_type validation locks in old inventory values — both controllers validate scan_type as in:check_in,check_out,audit,transfer. Any rename of the enum requires a coordinated change to both validation rules and a migration.
